key.name: appendages
key.summary: JSON array describing appendage workspaces in linear order.
key.description: Each entry: {"col": int, "dir": "up"|"down"}. The i-th entry corresponds to the workspace at linear index (main-row-size + i).

key.name: main-row-size
key.summary: Recorded size of the main horizontal row.

key.name: forget-empty-on-disable
key.summary: Forget empty appendages when the extension is disabled.

key.name: branched-indicator
key.summary: Render branches inside the native Activities preview.
key.description: When enabled (default), the GNOME Activities workspace dots are replaced with a 2D variant: the main row uses native dots (preserving scale/expansion animations) and small bars above/below each column represent vertical appendages. When disabled, falls back to a separate standalone panel indicator.

key.name: indicator-show-branches
key.summary: Show vertical branches in the indicator.
key.description: When the Activities indicator is in branched mode, controls whether vertical bars for appendages are shown. When disabled, only the main horizontal row is drawn — useful if you keep using vertical workspaces but prefer a clean, native-looking indicator.

key.name: switch-up
key.summary: Switch to workspace above current column.

key.name: switch-down
key.summary: Switch to workspace below current column.

key.name: switch-left
key.summary: Switch to workspace to the left within main row.

key.name: switch-right
key.summary: Switch to workspace to the right within main row.

key.name: move-window-left
key.summary: Move active window to the left within main row.

key.name: move-window-right
key.summary: Move active window to the right within main row.

key.name: create-up
key.summary: Create and switch to a new appendage above current column.

key.name: create-down
key.summary: Create and switch to a new appendage below current column.

key.name: extend-row-right
key.summary: Extend main row with a new column on the right.

key.name: move-window-up
key.summary: Move active window to workspace above.

key.name: move-window-down
key.summary: Move active window to workspace below.
